_doc: Tier A coverage map (in-place-image-convergence 1.2). One entry per tier A destination of image-files.manifest. level behaviour: committing the evidence mutation of src makes the named accepted fixture(s) FAIL in gate/shadow-eval.sh; parse: only a syntax mutation does; none: no fixture fails. A tooling path converges in place only at level behaviour with src inside gate_paths; everything else is converged by the image. reason for none: outside-gate-paths (src is not a gate path), units-exempt (see units_exempt), converges-today-uncovered (pull-sync installs it today with no fixture), unreached (baked only). src_blob is the git blob the proof ran on; a live src blob that differs means the proof is older than the code and must be re-earned. Kept consistent by validation/scripts/image-coverage-map.test.sh; proofs re-run by image-coverage-map.check.sh.

units_exempt.reason: converges today; gated after a unit-verify fixture exists
